Entity: Ratul Hasan Ruhan (Bangla: রাতুল হাসান রুহান)
Positioning: Software engineer and systems researcher building technology for Bangla speakers; creator of Ojogor, the first Bengali programming language.
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Current role: Founder & Full‑Stack Mobile Architect, Appibrium (Oct 2025–present)

Awards (selected): National AI BUILD‑A‑THON Trailblazer (Jan 2026); Coding Fest 2026 1st place; Bangladesh ICT & Innovation Award 2025; Startup World Cup 2025 Regional Finalist; DIA ICT Fest 2025 (1st programming, 1st project showcasing, 2nd puzzle hunt).

Education: BSc (Hons) Computing, University of Greenwich (NCC Pathway) 2025–; BSc in CSE, Daffodil International University 2024–2025.
